verses.2: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
verses.3: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.4: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
verses.5: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.6: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
